item.title: Trivium: VCF/VCA/Envelope combo from Weston Precision Audio & Trovarsi
item.description: video upload by CatSynth TV "LA-based electronic music composer/artist Trovarsi takes us on a tour of Trivium, a new module developed in collaboration with Weston Precision Audio, at Buchla & Friends 2026.
